name: Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd. (浙江零跑科技股份有限公司)
note: EV maker listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX 09863). Per its 2025 annual report (HKEX filing, published 29 April 2026), as at 31 December 2025 the 'Single Largest Group of Shareholders' is founder Zhu Jiangming acting in concert with Fu Liquan and their spouses (each deemed interested in 337,618,377 shares, 23.75% of total share capital); Stellantis N.V. holds 284,260,030 shares (19.99%); Hangzhou state-backed pre-IPO fund Guoshun Lingpao holds 12,107,202 shares (0.85%). No larger holder is disclosed.
